name: Erdos Problem 81 proof claim v0.1.0
body:
Proof-claim submission snapshot for the proposed solution of Erdos Problem 81.

## Claim

For all sufficiently large n, the maximum clique-partition number among n-vertex chordal graphs is floor(n(n+1)/6). In particular, every n-vertex chordal graph has a clique partition of size n^2/6 + O(n).

## Included verification

- Complete Lean formalization of the new argument and its end-to-end assembly.
- No sorry declarations or custom axioms.
- Replayable finite LP, packing, symmetrization, and rigidity certificates.
- A 17-page LaTeX manuscript and reproducibility documentation.
- Full make check run passed immediately before this tag was created.

## Explicit external trust boundary

The final Lean theorem is conditional on three visible interfaces corresponding to published results:

1. Vizing edge-colouring theorem.
2. Haggkvist--Janssen list edge-colouring theorem for complete graphs.
3. Rohatgi--Urschel--Wellens finite-family packing-transfer theorem, specialized to triangle gain 2 and K4 gain 5.

These external results are cited and used as ordinary mathematical inputs; they have not been reproved inside Lean. This snapshot is a proof claim awaiting independent specialist review, not a declaration that human review is complete.
